description: Receiving scan of a NIDEC QR label failed to match/resolve item CHS-04TB(34), although the part exists in the parts table
reproSteps: Receiving detail → scan NIDEC QR: `236301041541  CHS-04TB(34)  1000  1284  C6J  609080257MMJ805744571C` → item is not matched (expected: resolves to CHS-04TB(34), which exists in the parts table)
remarks: Fixed — commit 3f6af0dc. Root cause: COPAL/NIDEC QR template itemId class excluded parentheses, so 'CHS-04TB(34)' never matched. Widened [A-Z0-9 ./-] to include ( ), mirrored in restore SQL + data migration 0056; retest on a real NIDEC reel label
